info.text:
Car insurance jumped 57% in four years. Why?
BLS price data: +14.2% in 2022, +20.3% in 2023, +11.3% in 2024, +2.8% in 2025 (December to December).
Why: insurers spent about $112 on claims and costs per $100 of premium in 2022 as repairs and claims got pricier, then raised rates. By 2025 it was about $92.
Prices eased 5.1% in the year to August 2026, a small dip after a big climb.
Sources: BLS Consumer Price Index; Triple-I personal auto results.
News and education, not financial advice.
